definitions.explanation: A container or structure for storing water. Found on building rooftops, underground, or as standalone tanks for water supply, fire prevention, or emergency use.

examples.japanese: {貯水槽|ちょすいそう}を{清掃|せいそう}する。
マンションの{屋上|おくじょう}に{大|おお}きな{貯水槽|ちょすいそう}がある。
examples.english: There is a large water tank on the rooftop of the apartment building.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}に{備|そな}えて、{地下|ちか}に{貯水槽|ちょすいそう}を{設置|せっち}する{自治体|じちたい}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More municipalities are installing underground water tanks in preparation for earthquakes.

notes:
Composed of {貯水|ちょすい} (water storage) and {槽|そう} (tank, vat). Japanese buildings commonly use rooftop {貯水槽|ちょすいそう} to maintain consistent water pressure.

By law, {貯水槽|ちょすいそう} in Japan must be cleaned and inspected regularly to ensure water quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貯水槽|ちょすいそう}を{設置|せっち}する (to install a water tank)
- {貯水槽|ちょすいそう}の{清掃|せいそう} (water tank cleaning)
- {貯水槽|ちょすいそう}の{点検|てんけん} (water tank inspection)
- {受水槽|じゅすいそう} (receiving water tank, related term)
